laws.rule: Tsavo East National Park (Taita-Taveta County), KWS rates: non-resident adults US$80 (about A$114 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), children US$40 (about A$56.82 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Gates 6 am to 6 pm. Single-use plastic is prohibited; stay in vehicles except at designated areas, keep 20 m from wildlife, 40 km/h limit, no off-road driving, no feeding wildlife.
laws.heading: Tsavo East National Park rates and rules

local-law.note: KWS park fees under Legal Notice 160 of 2025 (in force 1 October 2025). (No RBA rate for KES; at the Central Bank of Kenya rate of 29 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 91.4918 KES)

layers.process: Kisite Mpunguti Marine National Park (Kwale County, south of Diani), non-resident: adult USD 25 (about A$35.51), child USD 15 (about A$21.31). (A$ at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040.)

zone-requirements.note: Kisite Mpunguti only. Lamu not found on an official page.
